COPY <<'CDCTRACE' /cdc-trace.yaml
# The change feed's transaction trace, joined onto every row: shared by every
# stream reading cdc-events through the transform's `-r`, since streams mode
# refuses resources in a stream's own file.
#
# A writing transaction's first change on the bus is its marker
# (mecha.txn_trace, rls.sql), and conduit does not interleave transactions, so
# the marker last read is the transaction of every row after it. A row's own
# txid cannot answer instead: the bus spells a delete as its before-image,
# indistinguishable from an insert, and that image's txid, where it carries
# more than its key, is its last writer's.
#
# A stream runs this among its INPUT processors, which Connect runs on one
# goroutine whatever the pipeline's threads, after stamping @cdc_consumer with
# a name no other stream uses: the cache is one per process, and each stream
# reads the bus at its own position. The marker is consumed and dropped; a
# row leaves with @traceparent set to its transaction's trace, or unset when
# the transaction had none or began before this process read its marker.
cache_resources:
  - label: cdc_trace
    memory:
      # One entry per stream, replaced by every marker: the TTL bounds nothing
      # and only has to outlast the longest transaction's rows (the default
      # is 5m).
      default_ttl: 24h
  - label: cdc_epoch
    memory:
      # The epoch each reader's group had when this process first read it,
      # kept for the process's life.
      default_ttl: 876000h
  - label: cdc_sweep
    memory:
      # A pipeline's aggregate, read once for the rows its start sweeps.
      default_ttl: 1h

processor_resources:
  # Redis Streams delivers single-message batches. Missing declared readers
  # hold the stream intact while their groups are still being registered. A
  # reader under durable retry (CDC_RETRY_GROUPS) also hands its crash loops to
  # its retry stream: a record that kills the process leaves no copy in memory,
  # only a delivery count that grows with every restart. A declared group past
  # CDC_GROUP_BUDGET (lag + pending entries) is destroyed and its epoch deleted
  # so trimming proceeds and its reader restarts to sweep on return.
  #
  # Every group has an epoch in Redis, set when the guard first sees it. A
  # Redis that lost its data, a group retired past its budget, or a slot_reset
  # marker from Conduit clears epochs and stops readers so their restart
  # rebuilds from the current rows.
  - label: cdc_stream_trim
    branch:
      request_map: |
        let reset = this.catch({}).data.or("").catch("").parse_json().catch({}).__table.or("") == "slot_reset"
        let wake = @redis_stream.or("") == "" && env("CDC_GROUPS").or("") != "" && (@cdc_via.or("") == "wake" || this.catch({}).wake.or("") == "start")
        root = if @redis_stream.or("") != "" && (batch_index() == 0 || $reset) { if $reset { @redis_stream } else { "" } } else if $wake && batch_index() == 0 && @cdc_consumer.or("") != "" { "wake" } else { deleted() }
      processors:
        - redis_script:
            url: ${REDIS_URL}
            keys_mapping: 'root = ["cdc-events"]'
            args_mapping: 'root = [@cdc_consumer.or(""), env("CDC_RETRY_GROUPS").or("[]"), env("CDC_MAX_DELIVERIES").or("5"), env("CDC_GROUP_BUDGET").or("100000"), content().string()].concat(env("CDC_GROUPS").parse_json())'
            script: |
              #!lua flags=allow-oom
              if #ARGV <= 5 then return redis.error_reply('CDC_GROUPS must name the stream readers') end
              local consumer, max, budget, reset_id = ARGV[1], tonumber(ARGV[3]), tonumber(ARGV[4]), ARGV[5]
              if not budget or budget <= 0 then return redis.error_reply('CDC_GROUP_BUDGET must be positive') end
              if reset_id == 'wake' then
                if consumer ~= '' and redis.call('EXISTS', 'cdc-retired:' .. consumer) == 1 then
                  if redis.call('EXISTS', KEYS[1]) == 1 then
                    redis.call('XGROUP', 'DESTROY', KEYS[1], consumer)
                  end
                  redis.call('XGROUP', 'CREATE', KEYS[1], consumer, '$', 'MKSTREAM')
                  redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-retired:' .. consumer)
                  redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-epoch:' .. consumer)
                end
                return ''
              end
              local groups = {}
              for _, group in ipairs(redis.call('XINFO', 'GROUPS', KEYS[1])) do
                local fields = {}
                for i = 1, #group, 2 do fields[group[i]] = group[i + 1] end
                groups[fields['name']] = fields
              end
              if reset_id ~= '' and consumer ~= '' and redis.call('GET', 'cdc-reset:' .. consumer) ~= reset_id then
                for i = 6, #ARGV do
                  redis.call('SET', 'cdc-reset:' .. ARGV[i], reset_id)
                  redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-epoch:' .. ARGV[i])
                end
                if groups[consumer] then redis.call('XACK', KEYS[1], consumer, reset_id) end
                return 'reset'
              end
              local retired_self = false
              for i = 6, #ARGV do
                local name = ARGV[i]
                local fields = groups[name]
                if fields then
                  local behind = (tonumber(fields['pending']) or 0) + (tonumber(fields['lag']) or 0)
                  if redis.call('EXISTS', 'cdc-retired:' .. name) == 1 then
                    if behind > budget then
                      redis.call('XGROUP', 'DESTROY', KEYS[1], name)
                      redis.call('XGROUP', 'CREATE', KEYS[1], name, '$', 'MKSTREAM')
                      redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-epoch:' .. name)
                      redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-retired:' .. name)
                      groups[name] = {pending = 0, lag = 0}
                      if name == consumer then retired_self = true end
                    else
                      redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-retired:' .. name)
                    end
                  elseif behind > budget then
                    redis.call('XGROUP', 'DESTROY', KEYS[1], name)
                    redis.call('DEL', 'cdc-epoch:' .. name)
                    redis.call('SET', 'cdc-retired:' .. name, '1')
                    groups[name] = nil
                  end
                end
              end
              local epoch = ''
              if consumer ~= '' and not retired_self then
                local now = redis.call('TIME')
                redis.call('SET', 'cdc-epoch:' .. consumer, now[1] .. '.' .. now[2], 'NX')
                epoch = redis.call('GET', 'cdc-epoch:' .. consumer)
              end
              for _, group in ipairs(cjson.decode(ARGV[2])) do
                if group == consumer and groups[group] and not retired_self then
                  for _, p in ipairs(redis.call('XPENDING', KEYS[1], group, '-', '+', 100)) do
                    if p[4] > max then
                      local entry = redis.call('XRANGE', KEYS[1], p[1], p[1])[1]
                      if entry then redis.call('XADD', group .. '-retry', '*', unpack(entry[2])) end
                      redis.call('XACK', KEYS[1], group, p[1])
                    end
                  end
                  redis.call('XTRIM', group .. '-retry', 'MAXLEN', '~', 10000, 'LIMIT', 1000, 'ACKED')
                end
              end
              local complete = true
              for i = 6, #ARGV do
                if not groups[ARGV[i]] and redis.call('EXISTS', 'cdc-retired:' .. ARGV[i]) == 0 then complete = false end
              end
              if complete then redis.call('XTRIM', KEYS[1], 'MAXLEN', '~', 10000, 'LIMIT', 1000, 'ACKED') end
              if retired_self then return 'retired' end
              return epoch
        - catch:
            - crash: 'CDC stream trimming failed: ${! error() }'
        - switch:
            - check: 'this.catch("") == "reset"'
              processors:
                - crash: 'the bus slot was lost for ${! @cdc_consumer }: restarting to rebuild'
            - check: 'this.catch("") == "retired"'
              processors:
                - crash: 'the retired group ${! @cdc_consumer } was advanced to the stream tail: restarting to rebuild'
            - check: 'this.catch("") != ""'
              processors:
                - mapping: 'meta cdc_epoch = content().string()'
                - cached:
                    cache: cdc_epoch
                    key: '${! @cdc_consumer.or("") }'
                    processors:
                      - mapping: 'root = @cdc_epoch'
                - switch:
                    - check: '@cdc_epoch != "" && content().string() != @cdc_epoch'
                      processors:
                        - crash: 'the bus lost what ${! @cdc_consumer } had not read (its epoch is ${! @cdc_epoch }, not ${! content() }): restarting to rebuild'

  - label: cdc_trace_join
    # A batch runs each processor over every message before the next, so a
    # marker mid-batch would reach the rows after it only once the batch had
    # already read the cache; for_each runs the batch a message at a time.
    for_each:
      - switch:
          - check: '@cdc_consumer.or("") == ""'
            processors:
              - crash: a cdc-events stream ran cdc_trace_join without stamping @cdc_consumer
          - check: this.catch({}).data.or("").catch("").parse_json().catch({}).__table.or("") == "txn_trace"
            processors:
              # A marker without its NOT NULL trace keeps the error and stays
              # on the stream, where the consumer refuses it as it would any
              # malformed row.
              - try:
                  - mapping: |
                      let trace = this.data.parse_json().traceparent
                      root = if $trace.type() == "string" { $trace } else { throw("txn_trace marker has no traceparent") }
                  - cache:
                      resource: cdc_trace
                      operator: set
                      key: ${! @cdc_consumer }
                      value: ${! content() }
                  - mapping: root = deleted()
          - check: this.catch({}).data.or("").catch("").parse_json().catch({}).__table.or("") == "slot_reset"
            processors:
              - mapping: root = deleted()
          - processors:
              - branch:
                  request_map: root = ""
                  processors:
                    - cache:
                        resource: cdc_trace
                        operator: get
                        key: ${! @cdc_consumer }
                    # No marker read yet: the transaction's trace is unknown.
                    - catch:
                        - mapping: root = ""
                  result_map: meta traceparent = if content().string() != "" { content().string() } else { deleted() }

  # A coalesced call's @traceparent, over a batch archived as a JSON array whose
  # elements carry their row's @traceparent as `trace` (archive keeps no
  # metadata): the first transaction's trace, the one that set the call off.
  - label: cdc_trace_batch
    mutation: |
      let traces = this.map_each(m -> m.trace).filter(t -> t != "")
      meta traceparent = if $traces.length() > 0 { $traces.index(0) } else { deleted() }

CDCTRACE

COPY <<'DURABLERETRY' /durable-retry.yaml
# Durable retry's start, a stream of its own beside the readers'. Each group
# under durable retry (CDC_RETRY_GROUPS) moves its dead letters back to its
# retry stream once, so the release that fixes a poison record also redrives
# it, and the bus's state is logged where an operator reads the transform:
# per group, what was redriven, what is pending and how far it lags.
input:
  generate:
    count: 1
    interval: ""
    mapping: 'root = {}'
pipeline:
  processors:
    - mapping: 'root = if env("CDC_RETRY_GROUPS").or("[]") == "[]" { deleted() } else { this }'
    - redis_script:
        url: ${REDIS_URL}
        keys_mapping: 'root = ["cdc-events"]'
        args_mapping: 'root = env("CDC_RETRY_GROUPS").parse_json()'
        script: |
          local state = {}
          if redis.call('EXISTS', KEYS[1]) == 1 then
            for _, group in ipairs(redis.call('XINFO', 'GROUPS', KEYS[1])) do
              local fields = {}
              for i = 1, #group, 2 do fields[group[i]] = group[i + 1] end
              state[fields['name']] = fields
            end
          end
          local report = {}
          for _, group in ipairs(ARGV) do
            local dead = group .. '-dead'
            local entries = redis.call('XRANGE', dead, '-', '+')
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
              redis.call('XADD', group .. '-retry', '*', unpack(entry[2]))
            end
            redis.call('DEL', dead)
            local fields = state[group] or {}
            report[group] = {redriven = #entries, pending = fields['pending'] or 0, lag = fields['lag'] or cjson.null}
          end
          return cjson.encode(report)
    - catch:
        - crash: 'durable retry redrive failed: ${! error() }'
    - log:
        level: INFO
        message: 'durable retry at start: ${! content() }'
output:
  drop: {}

DURABLERETRY

COPY <<'COMPUTE' /compute-events.yaml
input:
  broker:
    inputs:
      - redis_streams:
          url: ${REDIS_URL}
          streams: [cdc-events]
          body_key: data
          consumer_group: ${COMPUTE_GROUP}
          client_id: compute
          start_from_oldest: true
          auto_replay_nacks: true
          # A backlog is read in large steps so one batch below drains much of it.
          limit: 1000
      # A change the bus lost while Redis restarted, the group was retired, or
      # the slot reset was never heard; the start invalidates every computation.
      - generate:
          count: 1
          interval: ""
          mapping: 'root = {"wake": "start"}'
  # The transform's -r cdc-trace.yaml consumes the transaction markers and
  # stamps each row's @traceparent.
  processors:
    - mutation: meta cdc_consumer = env("COMPUTE_GROUP")
    - resource: cdc_stream_trim
    - resource: cdc_trace_join
pipeline:
  threads: 1
  processors:
    - mapping: |
        let table = if this.exists("wake") { null } else { this.data.parse_json().__table }
        root.tables = if this.exists("wake") {
          null
        } else if $table.type() == "string" && $table != "" {
          [$table]
        } else {
          throw("CDC event has no table")
        }
        root.trace = @traceparent.or("")
output:
  switch:
    cases:
      - check: errored()
        output:
          reject: ${! error() }
      # An invalidation says the named tables changed since the last run, and
      # the receiver durably merges them before acknowledging. Each period
      # sends the union of changed tables; compute's PostgreSQL ledger keeps
      # one pending successor while a claimed calculation runs. A stream
      # acknowledgment means durable acceptance, not finished statistics.
      #
      # Compute answers a failed delivery 500, the error in the body, and keeps
      # serving; the batch is retried here as the one message it became, with
      # exponential backoff. A delivery still refused after twelve retries
      # (about eight minutes of backoff) is no transient failure: crash, so the
      # stack fails loudly. The delivery stays pending and is replayed first
      # when Connect restarts.
      - output:
          broker:
            pattern: fan_out
            batching:
              count: 10000
              period: 1s
              processors:
                - archive:
                    format: json_array
                - resource: cdc_trace_batch
                - mapping: |
                    root.tables = if this.any(m -> m.tables == null) { null } else { this.map_each(m -> m.tables).flatten().unique() }
            outputs:
              - fallback:
                  - retry:
                      backoff:
                        initial_interval: 1s
                        max_interval: 1m
                        max_elapsed_time: 0s
                      max_retries: 12
                      output:
                        http_client:
                          url: ${COMPUTE_URL:http://compute:9997}/invalidate
                          verb: POST
                          timeout: 30m
                          retries: 0
                          max_in_flight: 1
                          headers:
                            Content-Type: application/json
                            Authorization: Bearer ${SERVICE_JWT:}
                          metadata:
                            include_patterns: ["^traceparent$"]
                  - drop: {}
                    processors:
                      - crash: 'compute refused an invalidation through every retry: ${! @fallback_error }'

COMPUTE

entrypoint.do: let mecha = (if ('services/transform/cdc-trace.yaml' | path exists) { $env.PWD } else { (^mise where github:bonisoft3/mecha | str trim) }); let tdir = (if (($env.MECHA_TRANSFORM_DIR? | default '') != '') { $env.MECHA_TRANSFORM_DIR } else { ($mecha | path join 'services/transform') }); let cdir = (if (($env.COMPUTE_APP_DIR? | default '') != '') { $env.COMPUTE_APP_DIR } else { ($mecha | path join 'services/compute') }); exec redpanda-connect streams --set ('http.enabled=' + ((($env.CDC_REPLAY_PORT? | default '') != '') | into string)) --set ('http.address=127.0.0.1:' + ($env.CDC_REPLAY_PORT? | default '0')) --no-api -r ($tdir | path join 'cdc-trace.yaml') ($tdir | path join 'durable-retry.yaml') 'docker/golaberto-rounds.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-team-enrichment.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-team-profiles.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-team-directory.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-matches-games.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-recent-championships.yaml' 'docker/golaberto-sofascore-admission.yaml' ($cdir | path join 'events.yaml')
